name: Agent Desktop
description: Reliable computer use for AI agents on the desktop. Built in Rust, it reads any app's real UI structure through OS accessibility trees and operates it - stable element refs and safe-to-retry actions instead of guessing from pixels.

pricing.note: Open source (Apache-2.0); npm + C-ABI FFI distribution

name: cftunnel
description: One-command intranet tunneling tool. Cloud mode exposes local services over HTTP/WS via Cloudflare Tunnel for free; Relay mode runs your own frp relay for full TCP/UDP protocol passthrough.

pricing.note: Open source (MIT); Cloudflare Tunnel cloud mode is free

name: FreshRSS
description: Self-hosted RSS feed aggregator written in PHP. Multi-user, extensible with extensions, Docker-ready, active development with frequent releases and broad i18n coverage.

name: JODConverter
description: Java library for converting documents via LibreOffice/OpenOffice in headless mode. Local and remote office managers, CLI, Spring/Spring Boot starters - built for high-throughput server-side document conversion.

name: Scoold
description: Self-hosted Q&A and knowledge-sharing platform for teams, inspired by Stack Overflow. Enterprise-ready, database-agnostic and lightweight; deploys anywhere (Docker, Heroku, AWS, Azure, VPS).

pricing.note: Open source (Apache-2.0) + Scoold Pro premium tier, flat perpetual license
